class.name: VehicleComponentInfo
class.brief_description: A component a vehicle's implementation can make.
class.description: What [method VehicleServer.component_list] lists of an implementation: the name it makes the component by ([method VehicleServer.component_create]), its title for a list, and its kind.

members.member: The component's kind - a [enum VehicleComponentType.Type], or a kind of vehicle's own numbered on from it ([enum RailVehicleComponentType.Type]) - as the component answers it.
The name the implementation makes the component by.
The component's title, for a list to show.
